verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI documents explicit multi-agent patterns including agent delegation (one agent calls another as a tool and regains control) and programmatic agent hand-off, plus durable execution and message-history sharing to support workflows spanning multiple agent runs. It lacks a dedicated 'crew'-style orchestrator or built-in graph/router abstraction beyond delegation and manual hand-off patterns, and one community report notes teams had to build significant custom glue for multi-agent production wiring. Missing for 10: a first-party crew/team orchestration primitive, independent hands-on validation of complex multi-agent handoff reliability.
